selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This gap is the most load-bearing empirical-reveal target because it asks whether endpoint success is evidentially sufficient, yet it can be answered without claiming an exhaustive strategy grammar, global path necessity, or full functional-geometric understanding. controlled_diagnostic_design closes the measurable residue with exact matched-state geometry pairs and a within-recipient action-compatibility interaction; the retry must include an actual geometry-neutral common-prefix or initial-state producer, block post-treatment state mismatch at the queried chunk, and scope the result to visible-geometry-conditioned current-action compatibility.
